items.exampleEn: Greek mythology is full of gods and heroes.
items.exampleZh: 希臘神話裡充滿了眾神與英雄。

items.exampleEn: School plays an important role in children's socialization.
items.exampleZh: 學校在兒童的社會化過程中扮演重要的角色。

items.exampleEn: The old bridge is a testament to the builders' skill.
items.exampleZh: 這座老橋證明建造者的技術十分高超。

items.exampleEn: The villagers revere the old tree as a symbol of luck.
items.exampleZh: 村民把那棵老樹當成好運的象徵來崇敬。

items.exampleEn: Her warning about the storm turned out to be prophetic.
items.exampleZh: 她對暴風雨的警告，後來證明是有先見之明的。

items.exampleEn: This year, more families chose to travel domestically.
items.exampleZh: 今年有更多家庭選擇在國內旅遊。

items.exampleEn: Many cultures believe in the sanctity of human life.
items.exampleZh: 許多文化都相信人命是神聖的。

items.exampleEn: Volunteering abroad is often driven by altruism.
items.exampleZh: 出國當志工常常是出於利他精神。

items.sentenceEn: My daughter reads a book of mythology before bed.
items.sentenceZh: 我女兒睡前會讀一本神話書。

items.audioEn: Most of our rice is grown domestically, not brought in from abroad.
items.audioZh: 我們的米大多是國內種植的，不是從國外進口的。
items.questionZh: 他們的米大多從哪裡來？
options: It is grown in their own country
It comes from their own garden

items.sentenceEn: Many people revere him as a great teacher.
items.sentenceZh: 許多人尊崇他為一位偉大的老師。

items.sentenceEn: Her altruism inspired the whole class to help others.
items.sentenceZh: 她的無私精神激勵全班一起幫助別人。

items.stemEn: Many modern films borrow stories from ancient ____.
items.stemZh: 許多現代電影借用古代神話裡的故事。

items.stemEn: Even today, young painters ____ her and copy her style.
items.stemZh: 直到今天，年輕畫家仍崇敬她、模仿她的畫風。

items.passageEn: Every spring, the people of a mountain village hold a festival for a river spirit from local mythology. Older villagers say the river has a kind of sanctity, so nobody is allowed to fish there during the festival. To a visiting professor, the event was clear testament to the village's profound respect for nature. She also pointed out its role in socialization: children learn the old songs from their grandparents and help prepare food for guests. The village's small craft company now sells its products domestically, and much of the money goes back to the festival, an example of quiet altruism.
items.passageZh: 每年春天，一座山村的居民都會為當地神話中的河神舉辦節慶。老一輩的村民說，這條河具有某種神聖性，所以節慶期間任何人都不可以在河裡捕魚。對一位來訪的教授來說，這個活動清楚證明村民對自然懷有深深的敬意。她也指出節慶在社會化上的作用：孩子們跟祖父母學唱老歌，也幫忙為客人準備食物。村裡的小型手工藝公司現在在國內販售產品，大部分收入都回饋給節慶，這是一種低調的利他精神。

questions.questionZh: 為什麼節慶期間不准在河裡捕魚？
options: 老一輩認為這條河具有某種神聖性
政府剛好規定這段時間禁漁
河水在春天太深太危險

questions.questionZh: 教授說這個節慶在社會化上有什麼作用？
options: 讓外地遊客認識山上的風景
孩子跟祖父母學老歌，也幫忙準備食物
讓忙碌的大人有機會休息

items.promptZh: 他十年前說的話，現在看來很有先見之明。
referenceEn: What he said ten years ago now seems prophetic.
His words from ten years ago now look prophetic.
rubricZh: prophetic 是形容詞，表示「有先見之明的、預言的」（例如 seems prophetic、prophetic words 等）
「現在看來」可寫，例如 now seems、now looks 等
「十年前說的話」可寫，例如 what he said ten years ago、his words from ten years ago 等

items.promptZh: 科學家發現，有些動物也會表現出利他行為。
referenceEn: Scientists have found that some animals also show altruism.
Scientists have discovered that altruism exists in some animals too.
rubricZh: 「利他行為」用 altruism（例如 show altruism 等）
「發現」可寫，例如 have found、discovered 等；時態配合內容；過去式、現在完成式都正確

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：疑似："It comes from a farm" 字面上也為真（國內種的米當然也來自農場），雖然沒回答「國內或國外」，但作答者可能爭議；建議換成明確錯誤的選項（例如 It is bought from a nearby country）。
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 換成音檔可明確排除的 It comes from their own garden

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正："Some villagers now sell their own crafts domestically"：對一個山村賣手工藝品用 domestically 不自然（domestically 通常用於公司、國家層級的銷售／生產），讀起來突兀；建議改成公司或合作社層級的情境，或改寫為 sell their crafts in shops around the country。
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 改成公司層級：The village's small craft company now sells its products domestically

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：參考答案 "Giving blood is a simple act of altruism." 是一般陳述，不是「你看過或做過的例子」，與題目要求及評分要點第 2 條不符（§10-①、§11-17）；建議改如 "I once saw a stranger help an old man carry his bags, a simple act of altruism."。
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 參考答案改成自己做過的例子：Last year, I gave my umbrella to a stranger in the rain, a small act of altruism.

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：第③關 B：mcq 與 l01 重複「鎮民崇敬蓋學校的人」
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 題幹改 Even today, young painters ____ her and copy her style.，代入後只有 revere 成立

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 自查修正：自查：domestically 卡與改寫後的閱讀都是「公司在國內販售產品」
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 卡改 This year, more families chose to travel domestically.

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：第③關：評分要點有「可寫 X 等」沒有「例如」、「常用 X」或寫死位置、時態（§11.23）
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 依執行長裁示統一改成「例如…等」或「X 的用法，例如…等」：prophetic 是形容詞，表示「有先見之明的、預言的」（例如 seems prophetic、prophetic words 等）／「現在看來」可寫，例如 now seems、now looks 等／「十年前說的話」可寫，例如 what he said ten years ago、his words from ten years ago 等

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 創辦人裁示：造句改翻譯：造句題（altruism）原位換成翻譯題，沿用題 id c1-u22-l02-q17；目標字沿用 altruism
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 改為 translate：promptZh「科學家發現，有些動物也會表現出利他行為。」、hintWords ["altruism"]、referenceEn ["Scientists have found that some animals also show altruism.","Scientists have discovered that altruism exists in some animals too."]、rubricZh ["「利他行為」用 altruism（例如 show altruism 等）","「發現」可寫，例如 have found、discovered 等；時態配合內容；過去式、現在完成式都正確"]（原 makeSentence：instructionZh「用 altruism 造一個句子，說說你看過或做過的一個無私助人的例子。」、referenceEn ["My neighbor shows real altruism by cooking for elderly people every week.","Last year, I gave my umbrella to a stranger in the rain, a small act of altruism."]）
